<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 59">Gen. R. s. 59</cite>, end <he>אניף במָגִינֵּיה</he> he swung his shield; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 107">Yalk. ib. 107</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 156">Yalk. Sam. 156</cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 77">Gen. R. s. 77</cite>, end <he>מגיניה דידין וכ׳</he> the shield of the one against that of the other; a. e.—Pl. <he>מָגִינִּין</he>, <he>מָגִינַּיָּיא</he>.
Targ. I Kings X, 17 (ed. Wil. מָגִנִּין); a. e.—בֵּית מָגִינַּיָּיא pr. n. pl. Beth Maginnaya (Shield-House).
